text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, we've arri~ved♪ It's an amusement 
park, Trainer!

I can't help feeling a bit embarrassed in 
this unfamiliar situation. As for how I 
ended up coming to an amusement park with 
Cesario, the clock turns back a few days—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A pair of amusement park tickets? Are 
these... for me?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Go ahead and take your friends if 
you'd like.

Yeah. If you want, go ahead and go with 
your friends.

text_block_list.text:
When I went to see a comedy with Cesario 
before, there was a campaign postcard 
tucked inside the questionnaire on the 
seat.

It was a campaign hosted by the amusement 
park sponsoring the play; after entering 
on a whim, we ended up winning a pair of 
amusement park tickets.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing! Congratulations on winning 
the prize!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Still, if I'm going, I'd rather go with 
you, Trainer... Especially if that comedy 
was what started it all!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I want to get to know you even better! 
Let's go to the amusement park together, 
just the two of us! ♪

And so, while the intention was to make 
Cesario happy, she ended up being the one 
looking out for me instead...

As the adult, I need to escort Cesario 
properly. I make a suggestion with my 
phone in hand, overflowing with bookmarked 
theme park guides.
choice_data_list:
How about the haunted house? Are you okay 
with scary things?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine with scary things. Sounds 
great! Let's go to the haunted house!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ooh, the atmosphere's getting pretty nice.
choice_data_list: Ah, watch out! Cesario, stay behind me!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer...? Um...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll leave the lead to you. 
However, that shadow over there looks 
suspicious, so be careful—

text_block_list.name: Bandage-Covered Ghost
text_block_list.text: GRAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer!? Wait, that path is...!

text_block_list.name: Ghost with Hanging Long Hair
text_block_list.text: Uuuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The route is this way! Trainer, please 
follow me!"
(Rumble, rumble, rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We've climbed up pretty high, haven't we? 
This roller coaster has a reputation for 
being quite terrifying, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I'm fine, but... Um, Trainer, are you 
really okay with this kind of thing...?"
choice_data_list: I'm fine, I'm fine, so... A-AAAAAAH!!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm right by your side! Please stay 
strong!!

Though I wanted to put on a cool, grown-up 
front, after surviving the haunted house 
and roller coasters, my legs were shaking 
like a newborn fawn...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!! Fufufu, hahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm sorry. It's just, Trainer, 
ufufu, you looked so scared... Ahahaha!

Cesario is laughing with tears in her 
eyes. While it is an endearing sight, it's 
surprising that she doesn't seem scared in 
the slightest.
choice_data_list:
Cesario has such a strong heart, she's so 
cool.

Cesario is so strong-hearted and cool, 
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I've always been fine with this kind 
of thing.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're quite sensitive—or should 
I say, so honest even when you're scared. 
It's adorable, and it really warmed my 
heart♪

As an adult, it was a bit... no, quite an 
embarrassing comment, but I was glad we 
got to discover a new side of each other.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You're looking much better. The park will 
be closing soon—which attraction would you 
like to visit last?
choice_data_list: Maybe the Ferris wheel would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let's relax and enjoy the scenery 
together♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Trainer, look! The sunset is dyeing 
the sky red and indigo!

Each of them took out their smartphones 
and snapped photos of the sky, richly 
colored like a masterpiece painting.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That was beautiful. Did you manage to take 
a photo too, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Got the shot. Wanna show each other how 
they turned out?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great...! My best shot would be 
this one...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe this one looks prettier after 
all? I really can't choose. I'll just show 
you all of them♪

Cesario and I exchanged smiles as we 
showed each other our countless sunset 
photos.

It turned out to be a great day that 
deepened our mutual understanding. Surely, 
what happened today will not be forgotten, 
even in the far-off future.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you really okay?

This amusement park is famous for its 
thrill rides, with the flying trapeze 
being its main attraction. I insisted that 
having come this far, we simply had to try 
it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Geez... If you insist that much, shall we 
go? If you get scared, you can hold my 
hand, okay?

...Or so I enthusiastically set out to do, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Fufu, hahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Heheh! Thanks for sticking with me 
till the end, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'll go grab something cold to drink from 
that stall over there, so please take a 
rest on the bench, Trainer.
choice_data_list: S-sorry... Ah, take my wallet with you
S-sorry... Ah, take my wallet with you

text_block_list.text:
Sitting on the bench she made me sit on, I 
let out a deep sigh. While I was glad if 
Cesario enjoyed herself, I couldn't help 
but feel utterly pathetic.

Even so, today is something I'm sure I 
won't forget even in the distant future. 
It turned out to be a wonderful day where 
we deepened our mutual understanding.
